description: A minimal API client for the chatbot frontend, providing a function to send messages to the backend chat API and handle responses, including URL resolution based on environment variables or window location.

methods.name: resolveBaseURL()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API requests, prioritizing environment variables and falling back to the window's origin with port 3001.

methods.name: chat(message)
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the backend API and returns the assistant's reply, handling errors and response parsing.
